name: Prison Life remastered (BETA)
desc:
A comepletely remastered version of the amazing game "Prison Life" by Aesthetical (https://www.roblox.com/games/155615604/Prison-Life)

This game is not endorsed by Aesthetical.

Will you keep order within the prison or will you cause chaos? The choice is yours.

Make sure to join the Communications Server to keep up to date!
